assumptions: E is any finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure, including dimension zero. V is real-valued and C²; α,β are nonnegative reals.
Exactly six analytic source hypotheses: α>0; α≤β; V∈C²; for all x,v, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖²; η>0; βη≤1. No third or higher derivative bound.

Standing E,V,α,β,η are fixed. y,xRef,z0,t,sample are arguments of one jointly Borel map. P and ε are literal canonical definitions; measurability, positive support, recurrence, cover and nonaccumulation are produced dependencies.

The deterministic covered-arc characterization and uncovered fallback hold for every sample. Actual all-time agreement and initialization hold on one AE sample event for each fixed parameter triple. No uniform AE event over uncountably many parameter triples and no arbitrary correlated random-parameter law are inferred.

A stopped record has no phase and infinite event time; every covering interval has a live finite record. The last infinite-wait live arc remains covered. The initial-phase fallback is an explicitly labelled ASTIS measurable extension only on the uncovered complement; zero-time exceptional bounces need not have source index0 at t0.

The same single Z supplies all outputs of one K, jointly indexed in deterministic y,xRef,z0 and every finite NNReal time; standing dynamics V,α,β,η stay fixed. The law is the actual exponential-clock full-phase pushforward, not ideal random-reference/momentum returned position at pi.
The bounded tests are Borel real g with every nonnegative global bound M; no continuity, differentiability, extra moment, supplied law or integrability premise is added. Rank0 and M=0 are included.

Zero-time law uses each fixed-parameter AE initialization; it does not assert all-sample zero-time identity or a common AE event over all parameters. Joint measurability alone does not justify correlated random-parameter substitution.

Probability-fiber Markov kernel is distinct from a Markov process. Actual restart/memorylessness/Chapman-Kolmogorov and phase invariance/path reversal remain independent open dependencies; kernel construction is only an optional representation for future invariance proofs.
units.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. In addition, for this same single actual Z there exists a probability kernel K from the jointly indexed space A=(((E×E)×(E×E))×[0,∞)) to the full phase E×E. For every deterministic y,xRef,z0 and finite t≥0, K((((y,xRef),z0),t))=P.map(sample↦Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)). Equivalently, for every Borel phase event B, K((((y,xRef),z0),t))(B)=P{sample:Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)∈B}. The probability kernel supplies Borel dependence of these event probabilities on all of y,xRef,z0,t simultaneously. At zero time its exact law is K((((y,xRef),z0),0))=δ_z0. For every Borel real-valued test g:E×E→ℝ and every M≥0 satisfying |g(z)|≤M for all z, g is integrable under each displayed K fiber, sample↦g(Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)) is integrable under the actual P, and ∫g(z)K((((y,xRef),z0),t))(dz)=∫g(Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample))P(dsample). The same Z and K precede every parameter, test and bound. All original six analytic assumptions and eleven literal definitions are retained; actual P probability, joint Z measurability, initialization, kernel existence and integrability are derived outputs, never convenience premises. All-finite jointly indexed kernel packaging is an attributed ASTIS measure-theoretic elaboration of the authors actual transition-law and bounded-measurable-test interface. The source terminal failed-limit0 convention and the total uncovered-initial-phase convention are distinct; only fixed-parameter AE compatibility of their laws is used. IsMarkovKernel means probability fibers here and asserts no process memorylessness, restart or Chapman-Kolmogorov equation. Actual invariance, path-law expansion/reversal, AE-safe all-L2 operators/Jensen contraction/density, hypocoercivity, implemented sampling, errors/unbounded query costs, composition and full main results remain separate OPEN obligations.

steps.title: Keep the actual clocks and the same physical phase
steps.text: Use the canonical countable Exp(1) product P and its existing probability theorem. Consume the verified actual physical-time phase producer with exactly the six original analytic assumptions. Its single Z retains joint measurability, every covered live arc, the uncovered-initial-phase convention and the fixed-parameter common-AE all-finite-time/initialization contract. No arbitrary supplied process is substituted.
steps.lean:
classical
  let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure P :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.UnitExponentialProduct.unit_exponential_product_laws.1
  obtain ⟨Z, hZM, harc, hfallback, hgood⟩ :=
    ActualPhysicalTimeMeasurability.actual_physical_time_measurable_phase
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη

steps.title: Reassociate the joint parameter and clock coordinates
steps.text: Write Param=((y,r),z), A=(Param,t). The measurable evaluation F((a,ω))=Z(y,r,z,t,ω) is obtained from the existing Param×(time×sample) measurable phase by the explicit product reassociation ((Param,t),ω)↦(Param,(t,ω)). Inserting a fixed Param and time gives each measurable clock section. This preserves joint index measurability rather than assuming it from separate sections.
steps.lean:
let A := ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0
  let F : A × (ℕ → ℝ) → E × E := fun a =>
    Z a.1.1.1.1 a.1.1.1.2 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2
  have hFM : Measurable F := hZM.comp
    (measurable_fst.fst.prodMk (measurable_fst.snd.prodMk measurable_snd))
  have hzM (y xRef : E) (z₀ : E × E) (t : ℝ≥0) :
      Measurable (Z y xRef z₀ t) := hZM.comp
    (show Measurable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => (((y, xRef), z₀), t, sample)) from
      measurable_const.prodMk (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id))
steps.detail: Exact contiguous compiled BODY region; earlier definitions/facts and enclosing subgoals remain in scope.

steps.title: Construct the jointly indexed probability kernel and exact fiber law
steps.text: At index a, Q=const(P) draws the actual clocks. Kernel.id×Q has fiber δ_a⊗P and is a probability kernel. Push it through measurable F to obtain K. The Dirac-product and map-composition identities give K(a)=map(ω↦F(a,ω))P exactly. Generic Mathlib kernel operations supply measurability and probability; they do not supply process Markovness.
steps.lean:
let Q : Kernel A (ℕ → ℝ) := Kernel.const A P
  let K : Kernel A (E × E) := (Kernel.id ×ₖ Q).map F
  have hK : IsMarkovKernel K := Kernel.IsMarkovKernel.map _ hFM
  have hfiber (y xRef : E) (z₀ : E × E) (t : ℝ≥0) :
      K (((y, xRef), z₀), t) = Measure.map (Z y xRef z₀ t) P := by
    dsimp only [K]
    rw [Kernel.map_apply _ hFM, Kernel.prod_apply, Kernel.id_apply,
      show Q (((y, xRef), z₀), t) = P from rfl,
      Measure.dirac_prod, Measure.map_map hFM (by fun_prop)]
    rfl

steps.title: Return the unchanged phase contract and identify every Borel event
steps.text: Return the same actual Z, all retained deterministic/AE clauses, and the constructed K. For any Borel phase event B, measurable pushforward evaluation gives K(a)(B)=P(Z_a^{-1}(B)). This is equality of the actual full-phase laws for every finite time and deterministic index.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨Z, hZM, harc, hfallback, hgood, K, hK, hfiber, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y xRef z₀ t B hB
    rw [hfiber, Measure.map_apply (hzM y xRef z₀ t) hB]
steps.detail: Exact contiguous compiled BODY region; earlier definitions/facts and enclosing subgoals remain in scope.

steps.title: Derive zero-time Dirac initialization from the actual AE event
steps.text: For each fixed y,r,z, the retained actual AE event implies Z(y,r,z,0,ω)=z for P-almost every ω. Pushforwards of AE-equal functions coincide, so the zero-time law is the pushforward of the constant z. Since P has mass one, this is δ_z. No parameter-uniform AE event or all-sample identity is needed.
steps.lean:
· intro y xRef z₀
    rw [hfiber]
    calc
      Measure.map (Z y xRef z₀ 0) P =
          Measure.map (fun _ : ℕ → ℝ => z₀) P :=
        Measure.map_congr ((hgood y xRef z₀).mono fun _ hs => hs.2)
      _ = Measure.dirac z₀ := by simp

steps.title: Prove both integrability statements and transfer the expectation
steps.text: For a Borel real g with |g|≤M, measurability and the finite probability of K(a) give g∈L1(K(a)). The measurable actual clock section composed with g is bounded by the same M, hence belongs to L1(P). Rewrite the fiber as the exact pushforward and apply the Bochner integral-map identity. This proves the displayed transition test identity with the actual clocks, including M=0; no unbounded cost transfer or invariance claim follows.
steps.lean:
· intro y xRef z₀ t g hg M hM hbound
    letI : IsMarkovKernel K := hK
    have hIntK : Integrable g (K (((y, xRef), z₀), t)) :=
      Integrable.of_bound hg.aestronglyMeasurable M
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound z)
    have hIntP : Integrable (fun sample => g (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)) P :=
      Integrable.of_bound (hg.comp (hzM y xRef z₀ t)).aestronglyMeasurable M
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun sample => by
          simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound (Z y xRef z₀ t sample))
    refine ⟨hIntK, hIntP, ?_⟩
    rw [hfiber]
    exact integral_map (hzM y xRef z₀ t).aemeasurable hg.aestronglyMeasurable
